jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller, Group Accounting & Controlling
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for a Senior Financial Controller to join our office in Copenhagen.

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Monthly controlling of accounts including cost controlling, balance sheet controlling and intercompany (IC) controlling

• Prepare and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborate with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Act as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

You have an MSc in Economics or Finance and 3-5 years of full-time experience in audit, financial controlling, or consultancy from a Big4 firm. You also have experience in consolidation and are motivated by building best practices, solving complex issues and developing the finance function.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

• Danish GAAP and consolidation principles knowledge

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written

• Experience with Business Central and OneStream is an advantage

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Student Assistant - Business Development and E-commerce

Are you analytically strong, curious about digital business and motivated by turning data into useful commercial insights?

Join us in a shared student role where you will support both our e-commerce activities and international business development work.

The role

You will work across two teams with data as the common thread. You will support recurring analyses and reporting, help create transparency from complex datasets, and contribute to material used for commercial decisions.

Your key tasks

• Collect, structure, validate, and analyse e-commerce, market, competitor, and other commercial data.

• Maintain recurring reports and performance overviews, and identify trends, gaps and potential business opportunities

• Turn complex data into clear insights, visualisations and presentations for commercial stakeholders and management

• Support e-commerce and business development projects by preparing analyses, consolidating input, and improving data-driven ways of working

What we are looking for

• You are studying at your last year at the bachelor's degree or at the master's level

• You are comfortable working with data and have solid Excel and Power BI skills. Experienced user of PowerPoint and AI tools is an advantage

• You work in a structured and detail-oriented way and can communicate findings clearly

• You are curious, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across teams and countries.

• You communicate confidently in English

What we offer

• A varied student role combining e-commerce and international business development tasks

• Hands-on experience with commercial analysis, management presentations and data-driven decision support

• Growing responsibility for recurring tasks, with guidance and sparring from experienced colleagues

• Flexible working hours that can be adapted to your studies. (Expect to be in office in Bjerringbro bi-weekly)

Why Grundfos

At Grundfos, we dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do. Our skills commit us to pioneer solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. Joining us as a student assistant, you too can drive this change while improving both your skills and resume. You become part of a close-knitted team in an inspiring, learning environment with access to great learning resources.

Practical information

Location:                    Remote and in Bjerringbro

Working hours:          10-15 hours/week

Start date:                  As soon as possible

Application deadline: We will close this job posting when we have found the right candidate, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible

Additional information

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Senior Business Development Manager, Henriette Drægert Grønning at +4540333919

Please send your resume and cover letter today by clicking on the link “Apply for this job”.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Desk Quant (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop financial models, applications, and quantitative solutions that support our trading of financial instruments in Nykredit Markets? Are you motivated by combining financial insight, technology, and quantitative analysis in a high-performing environment with strong expertise, significant responsibility, and visible impact? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly – a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Desk Quant who wants to work close to the business and contribute to developing and maintaining solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Trading support: Work closely with our trading desks and contribute to daily market activities where Dragonfly and other quant solutions are used.

• Financial modeling and quantitative analysis: Configure, analyze, and apply our models for pricing and risk management of financial products.

• Development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for the business.

• Model setup and risk calculations: Contribute to the setup, maintenance, and further development of models and risk calculations in both Dragonfly and other trading systems.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Markets-focused use of AI: Help identify and implement AI-driven solutions where they create business value.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong analytical skills and are motivated by solving complex financial challenges,

• have a solid understanding of quantitative modeling and financial theory,

• have programming experience in Python and strong Excel skills,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong performance focus and multiple parallel tasks,

• have an interest in financial markets and products.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Pricing & Structuring team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision support to remain at the forefront of the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contact me, David Sloth Pedersen, Head of Quantitative Solutions, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Software Tester who can drive testing activities across complex digital solutions. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and following up on testing efforts while working closely with business stakeholders, developers, product owners, and other teams.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can switch context between multiple initiatives during the day, and enjoys taking ownership of quality assurance from requirements through delivery.

While the primary focus is manual testing, experience with test automation or a strong interest in helping establish and expand automation capabilities is considered an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities

**Manual Testing

• Create and maintain comprehensive test plans and test strategies.

• Execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end tests.

• Validate user interfaces, user experience, usability, and business workflows.

• Test across multiple browsers, devices, systems, and environments.

• Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing to ensure overall solution quality.

• Test applications, websites, APIs, databases, and system integrations.

• Understand and validate business requirements, business rules, technical requirements, workflows, and processes.

• Document findings, defects, risks, and recommendations clearly and effectively.

Test Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Drive testing activities across projects and releases.

• Coordinate testing efforts with developers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and external partners.

• Facilitate alignment on testing scope, priorities, risks, and release readiness.

• Ensure testing activities are tracked, communicated, and followed through to completion.

Automation (Preferred)

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts.

• Identify suitable test scenarios and processes for automation.

• Execute automated test suites and analyse results.

• Maintain stable, reusable, and scalable automated tests.

• Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.

• Contribute to building and improving the organization's automation capabilities.

Qualifications & ExperienceWe are looking for someone who has:

• Solid experience in manual software testing.

• Experience creating test plans and coordinating testing activities.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance processes.

• Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, and backend systems.

• Knowledge of, or practical experience working with, ISTQB or TMAP testing frameworks.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to independently drive testing activities and follow up on actions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch context when needed.

Nice to HaveThe following are considered advantages but are not required:

• Hands-on experience implementing or expanding test automation.

• Experience working within a microservices architecture.

• Familiarity with Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, and database querying.

• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices.

• Certified in ISTQB or TMAP.

You Might Have a Background As

• Software Tester / QA Engineer

• Manual Tester

• Technical Product Owner with testing experience

• Software Developer with a passion for quality assurance

• Test Automation Engineer looking for a role with strong business engagement

Are you currently studying business, supply chain, or a related field - and looking to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, international work environment? Our Contract Manufacturing Operations department is looking for a structured and detail-oriented Student Assistant to support our Supplier Relationship Teams

About the job

As a Student Assistant you will become an integral part of our CMO department, where you will support our four SRT teams in a cross-functional capacity. Each team manages a cluster of external suppliers, and your role will be essential in ensuring smooth coordination and continuous product supply through collaboration with both suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your key tasks include:

• Sharing forecast and purchase orders with our global suppliers

• Processing Purchase Orders and coordination

• Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding order status and updates

• Supporting various operational activities across the SRT teams

There is an opportunity to build and expand your areas of responsibility, as personal and professional development is highly valued within Orifarm.

We are looking for someone who can work approximately 15 hours a week. However, we offer flexibility around exam periods.

Who are you?

We imagine that you are currently enrolled in higher education within business, purchasing, supply chain or similar.

The ideal candidate is:

• Highly organized and detail-focused

• Analytically skilled

• Comfortable communicating with a wide range of stakeholders – both internally and externally

• Proficient in English (written and spoken); Danish is a plus

• Confident using Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Who are we?

Our CMO department consists of 23 employees divided into 4 teams with the main objective of ensuring continuous and reliable product supply from our external suppliers within the two business areas: prescription medicine (Specialty) and OTC & Food Supplements.

You will work independently on various tasks after thorough training. Support and guidance are always available when needed, and you will be part of an ambitious and dynamic department where everyone is treated equally.

You will join 70 other talented student assistants from diverse educational backgrounds as part of our Student Network Orifarm (SNO). SNO organizes social and professional events, allowing you to expand your network and connect with other students across functions.

Why should you work for Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, giving you a valuable start to your career. As our student assistant, you may have the opportunity to complete an internship or collaborate with us on your bachelor’s or master’s thesis. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable healthcare accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Use AI to change how Orifarm’s commercial teams analyze, report and decide. We are looking for a senior insights professional who builds it, proves it and brings colleagues along

About the job

In this role, you will drive the change in how we work with data and insight; first in our own reporting and analysis, then across the commercial organization, together with colleagues in the markets, Finance and IT. We are looking for someone with natural curiosity who knows how to use modern technology to turn data into business insights, in a streamlined way, across the commercial organization.

You will:

• Lead the commercial transformation of our reporting and analysis (monthly market and commercial reporting, portfolio reviews, ad hoc requests) with AI: not just faster, but fundamentally better and less manual

• Build practical AI workflows and assistants, using approved tools such as Claude and Copilot, that work across multiple, large datasets, e.g. internal sales, profitability, market, CRM and pricing data, in close collaboration with the AI Office

• Accelerate the use of AI across the commercial organization, turning enterprise AI capabilities and principles into business value

• Define the commercial data and insight requirements needed to make AI use cases successful, working with the AI Office, IT, Finance and data owners on the appropriate data foundation

• Apply Orifarm’s AI governance and quality guardrails to commercial use cases, including validation and appropriate human review of AI-supported management output

You will report to the Director of Commercial Excellence & Insights and become part of the Market Insights & Support team, working closely with the commercial leadership and our AI office. This is a senior individual contributor role, based in Odense or Copenhagen, with a hybrid work model.

Who are you?

You are a commercially minded professional with 5+ years of experience in business analysis, commercial insights, reporting or business transformation. You understand how to turn complex data into clear recommendations that support decisions and improve commercial performance. Experience from the pharmaceutical industry is not required, as we can teach you the industry.

You are confident working with multiple, large datasets and tools such as Excel and Power BI, and you know AI’s limits well enough to validate its output. You use generative AI as a practical business tool to strengthen analysis, simplify workflows and improve the quality of insights, and you can show examples of where it has changed real work. You work within Orifarm’s approved tools and data-security guidelines and collaborate closely with Finance, IT and other specialists

Equally important, you are a strong communicator and change facilitator. You explain complex topics simply, build trust quickly and help colleagues, including senior stakeholders, adopt new ways of working. You are pragmatic, curious and quality-minded, with sound commercial judgement. You know when human review is essential, and you are not afraid to say “not yet” when the output is not good enough.

You are fluent in English. Danish is not required.

Who are we?

You will join a small, close team that supports the commercial organization with insight, data and systems, and sits right next to the commercial leadership team, so your work is seen and used. We are six colleagues including you, working closely together in a direct, hands-on and informal way. Orifarm has a flat structure and short paths to decision-makers.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of making affordable medicine accessible.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

• Build and operate the infrastructure for agentic AI workloads, including agent hosting, orchestration, and the platform capabilities needed to run them reliably at scale.

• Build toward a truly hybrid AI setup, pairing cloud-native AI capabilities with on-prem infrastructure so workloads can run wherever makes the most sense.

• Contribute to the guidance and standards coming out of the AI CoE, helping define what "good" looks like for agentic usage, credit and cost management, and agent scaling across the company.

• Strengthen and tune our Kubernetes workloads, making sure they run with the performance, resilience, and efficiency our business depends on.

• Drive a Platform Engineering approach to our cloud and AI infrastructure and tooling, working closely with Software Engineering teams and the AI CoE to build cohesive, developer-friendly experiences.

• Deliver on a modern, secure, and scalable cloud architecture, which you will help shape - one that's increasingly built with AI workloads in mind.

To succeed in this role, we are not just looking for someone who checks boxes - we're looking for someone honest, vocal, and unafraid to challenge the status quo when you see ways we can improve.

**Who are we looking for?

**So, if you enjoy spotting the glitches in the Matrix before anyone else does, or you’ve ever whispered "it's always DNS" to yourself (even when the culprit turned out to be a misbehaving agent), we consider that a positive sign.

Those qualities tend to go hand in hand with what we're looking for: someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working, and combines technical depth with a pragmatic mindset, helping us build and evolve the platform capabilities that support both today's cloud services and tomorrow's AI ambitions.

The skills that will help you thrive include:

• A solid grasp of the Azure Cloud ecosystem, understanding both its opportunities and its boundaries.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Bicep, and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and repeatability to how we build cloud resources.

• Comfort with scripting, whether your tool of choice is Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to automate tasks and streamline operational workflows.

• Experience with Kubernetes fundamentals, including deployments, services, and scaling.

• Curiosity about or exposure to AI infrastructure concepts - things like model hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, or GPU-backed workloads - even if you're not an AI expert yet.

• General familiarity with CI/CD and networking, giving you a well-rounded foundation for how we do cloud engineering.

**Welcome to Group IT

**When joining Group IT, you will be joining a digital transformation journey as we replace our legacy systems and transition towards a modular and flexible integrated setup. Group IT, a dynamic and rapidly evolving part of STARK Group, is responsible for delivering groupwide business-critical IT solutions. We strive to modernize and reimagine the IT landscape to ensure both scalability and composability to meet existing and future business needs, and we would like your help to rethink the way things are done in our industry to offer our customers a superior experience.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Magnus Bech Larsen, magnus.larsen@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy building things, solving practical technical challenges, and turning ideas into working solutions?

**Then you may be the person we're looking for to help establish our new prototype team.

**As our Lead Technician, you'll play a key role in building and testing prototype refrigeration systems that support development activities across Danfoss.

This is a highly hands-on role where you'll use your technical experience to build custom prototype setups, troubleshoot technical challenges, and help bring concepts to life. You'll work closely with engineers, technicians, and internal stakeholders across Danfoss, ensuring prototypes are built efficiently and projects move smoothly from start to finish.

The environment is dynamic, with multiple activities running in parallel and a strong focus on practical execution. While you'll take the technical lead on projects, this is not a people management role. Success comes from your ability to organize work, coordinate activities, and apply your technical knowledge to deliver working prototype solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Working as part of a newly established prototype team, you'll combine practical technical work with project coordination responsibilities.

• Build and assemble prototype refrigeration systems and custom test setup

• Coordinate prototype activities from project kick-off through completion, ensuring tasks and workflows are organized and progressin

• Work from electrical, thermal, and P&ID drawings to build and troubleshoot prototype system

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Danfoss, including colleagues without an engineering backgroun

• Support testing, problem-solving, and continuous improvements to prototype solutions and working methods

**What We're Looking For

**You enjoy practical technical work and are comfortable taking ownership of activities from planning through execution.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Educational background as a Marine Engineer, Automation Technician or similar technical discipline

• Experience building, assembling, or troubleshooting refrigeration systems or other complex technical equipment

• Experience coordinating technical tasks or projects in a workshop, manufacturing, service, or similar environment

• Ability to read and understand electrical, thermal, and P&ID drawings

• Working knowledge of AutoCAD, PCSCHEMATIC, or similar technical drawing tools

Knowledge of flow systems, fluid dynamics, and related technical documentation would be an advantage. Experience working with colleagues across different functions and locations is also beneficial.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

As part of a newly established prototype team, you'll have a unique opportunity to help shape how we work and influence the setup of future prototype activities. You'll work in a practical environment where ideas quickly become physical solutions and where your technical expertise will have a visible impact on projects across Danfoss.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For further information about the position, please contact our ADC team Manager, Nordborg, Thorsten Stöben, +45 5171 8579.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Lead global customer success and drive commercial growth across some of the world’s most influential media organizations.

Do you thrive at the intersection of customer success, commercial leadership, and strategic relationship management? Are you motivated by developing existing enterprise customers through complex solution sales while acting as a hands-on leader for an international team?

On behalf of Stibo DX, we are seeking an experienced Vice President, Customer Success RoW to lead customer success activities across Rest of World markets and play a central role in the company’s continued transformation towards a SaaS and recurring revenue business model. RoW includes several strategically important markets for Stibo DX, including Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, value realization, and commercial growth across Stibo DX’s global customer portfolio outside the DACH region and the Americas. This is a commercial leadership role focused on developing existing enterprise customers through complex, value-based solution sales. The role combines strategic account leadership, executive stakeholder management, commercial ownership, and people leadership of three people, and you will act as a hands-on player-coach for the team.

Based in Denmark, from either their headquarters in Aarhus or their Copenhagen office, you will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Customer Success Management.

You will lead the RoW Customer Success organization and be part of the global Customer Success leadership team alongside the regional leaders for DACH and the Americas.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, Support, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Executive Management to ensure customers maximize the value of their investment in the Cue Media Enterprise Platform while supporting Stibo DX’s ambitious growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will lead and further develop customer success across a strategically important international region that includes Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific. You will support existing customers through complex business and technology transformations while driving commercial expansion across the portfolio. Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning Customer Success performance across the RoW region, including retention, Net Revenue Retention, adoption, customer health, and commercial growth within the existing customer portfolio.

• Leading and developing an international Customer Success team as a hands-on player-coach while creating a high-performance culture focused on measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

• Building trusted executive-level relationships with strategic customers and personally leading selected key customer engagements and complex commercial opportunities.

• Driving customer value realization and supporting customers in maximizing business impact from the Cue platform while identifying opportunities to expand Stibo DX’s solutions across their organizations.

• Identifying and managing customer risks and growth opportunities while balancing long-term customer success with commercial objectives and driving complex, value-based solution sales.

• Contributing actively to the global Customer Success leadership team and helping shape best practices, processes, and strategic priorities across regions.

The Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced and commercially minded customer-facing leader with a proven track record from Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Sales, Professional Services, Consulting, or a similar function within B2B software and SaaS environments.

You understand what it takes to build long-term strategic customer relationships and create sustainable growth within an existing customer portfolio. You are comfortable shaping and driving complex commercial opportunities, engaging new stakeholders within customer organizations, and leading value-based solution sales from initial opportunity through negotiation and agreement. At the same time, you are a capable people leader who enjoys acting as a hands-on player-coach, developing the team and creating momentum around complex customer opportunities.

You bring credibility in executive-level dialogues and are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across customer organizations as well as internally across functions and geographies. You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on and distinctly commercial approach and are known for your ability to build trust, create alignment, and execute consistently.

Experience from subscription-based software businesses, SaaS transformations, or enterprise technology environments will be highly advantageous. Exposure to structured commercial methodologies such as MEDDPICC is considered a strong plus. Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities are considered beneficial, but not essential.

Why Join Stibo DX?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role at a company investing significantly in future growth, innovation, and product development. Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

Department Manager for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by electrical and instrumentation engineering and you thrive on combining people leadership with project execution, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Department Manager to join one of our Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) departments. As part of our E&I organisation, you will divide your time between project execution and department management, ensuring both successful project delivery and the continued development of your team.

Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) plays a key role in designing and delivering safe, reliable, and efficient pharmaceutical production facilities. Our work connects the physical production process with the systems that monitor, control, and safeguard it throughout the entire engineering lifecycle, from conceptual and detailed design to procurement, construction support, testing, commissioning, and qualification.

Your contribution will be important in developing people, strengthening technical excellence, and supporting the continued growth of our E&I capabilities as demand for complex pharmaceutical engineering solutions increases.

How you might spend your days

As a Department Manager, you’ll be:

• Leading and developing a team of approximately 11 employees and consultants

• Contributing to projects while providing technical and managerial leadership

• Managing resource allocation across projects and portfolios

• Driving employee, discipline, and competency development together with senior specialists

• Strengthening collaboration with colleagues in Denmark and Bangalore, India

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Skilled at bringing people together around a common purpose

• Result-oriented with a structured and proactive approach to leadership

• Focused on employee growth, engagement, and development

• Able to build strong professional relationships with customers and stakeholders

• Agile and comfortable prioritising in a dynamic project environment

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have at least 5 years of leadership experience

• You hold a BSc or MSc within Electrical Engineering, Automation or a related discipline

• You are fluent in written and spoken Danish and English

• You have knowledge of GMP and GEP requirements

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Alliance Management and Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Does it excite you to work with partners to bring new medicines to the market and to patients, and do you have experience with taking partnerships from early science through to launch? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

This Senior Director position reports to the SVP for Alliance Management, within a growing area of Commercial. The ambition is to evolve the mandate from ensuring partnerships are well governed and deliver against contractual obligations to maximizing the strategic, scientific and commercial value of our external partnerships across the asset lifecycle: from early science through development, regulatory approval, launch and lifecycle management. As we grow, the position offers the opportunity to build a "partner-to-market" value proposition for the entire organization and to shape the area that delivers it.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• Shape and drive the partner-to-market agenda, keeping the route to market in focus and contributing to the strategy, operating model and growth of the area

• Lead strategic partnership assessments, from partner identification and deal thesis development to close collaboration with Business Development and the identification of portfolio and capability gaps that partnerships can address

• Maximize the value of partnered assets through strong alliance governance, timely milestone delivery and proactive risk management across the partnership portfolio

• Drive cross-functional alignment between Zealand teams and partners, and resolve escalations and conflicts constructively and swiftly

• Prepare partnerships for commercial success through launch readiness, market access collaborations and co-commercialization models

• Unlock lifecycle expansion opportunities with partners, including new indications that extend the value of Zealand assets

Your profile

You are motivated by the path from molecules to market, and by combining Zealand's strengths with those of our partners to reach patients faster and further. Alliance management experience is a strength, and you have a genuine motivation to drive partnership progress with the patient always in view. You are a strategic and commercially minded partner who builds trust easily, influences without relying on formal authority, and is energized by building something new in a growing organization. Curiosity, resilience and a bold, collaborative approach come naturally to you.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in biopharma or big pharma, within partnering, business development, alliance management, commercial or development roles

• Deep understanding of drug development and commercialization, demonstrated through hands-on experience from regulatory approval, launch readiness, market access or co-commercialization, and the ability to connect early scientific decisions to commercial outcomes

• Strong strategic and commercial acumen, including deal structures, partnership economics and deal thesis development, with the ability to assess where a partnership creates the most value for patients and for Zealand across the asset lifecycle

• Solid understanding of US market dynamics, including pricing, payer and market access considerations that shape partnered commercial strategies

• Solid understanding and experience working with Chinese market is an advantage

• Ability to challenge early science and clinical development programs with the end product in mind, ideally with experience within obesity and metabolic health

Your new team

Alliance Management reports to the Executive Vice President for Commercial and works at the interface between our partners and our internal functions across research, development, regulatory, commercial and business development

Let's bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 12 November 2026 or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

About Zealand Pharma A/S

Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. Working at

Cimalys ApS

Cimalys helps Danish and Nordic companies put AI to work: safely, practically, and without hiring an AI team. Most companies with 20–300 employees know AI matters. Their staff already use ChatGPT, but with no policy, no approved tools and no idea where it actually saves time. Since February 2025, the EU AI Act has also required them to ensure their staff's AI literacy. Big consultancies are too expensive and slow for this size of company, and freelancers can't cover both strategy and the actual build. We start where the value is: a process audit that maps how a company actually works and pinpoints where AI and automation save real time and money. From there, we deliver exactly what each company needs: - AI literacy workshops: hands-on sessions where teams learn to use AI on their own work, safely, so they leave with working automations rather than notes about someday. - AI Foundation: a company-specific AI policy and a list of approved tools, so leadership knows what's allowed and employees know what to use. Operational guidance, not legal advice. - Custom automations and AI agents: built by our in-house developer and scoped from the audit, taking over the repetitive workflows that eat up people's days. Why us: the team that diagnoses the problem also builds the solution. No handover between a consultant who writes a report and a vendor who has to reinterpret it. No pyramid of juniors learning at the client's expense. Clear, fixed-scope offers, delivered fast. Why now: AI adoption in small and mid-sized companies is happening anyway, mostly unmanaged. Employees paste client data into free tools, every department picks its own apps, and leadership has no overview. The companies that put structure in place now will compound the gains, and the rest will spend the next years cleaning up. We want to be the partner that gets them there first. Where we are: Cimalys is an early-stage, founder-led company with delivery capacity in place and a productized offer ready to sell. What we need now is someone who loves opening doors and closing deals, so we can bring this to many more companies.
